source.author: verg
source.text: Ipse inter medios, Veneris iustissima cura, Dardanius caput ecce puer detectus honestum, qualis gemma micat, fulvum quae dividit aurum, aut collo decus aut capiti; vel quale per artem inclusum buxo aut Oricia terebintho lucet ebur; fusos cervix cui lactea crinis accipit et molli subnectens circulus auro.
source.text_original: Ipse inter medios, Veneris iustissima cura, / Dardanius caput ecce puer detectus honestum, / qualis gemma micat, fulvum quae dividit aurum, / aut collo decus aut capiti; vel quale per artem / inclusum buxo aut Oricia terebintho / lucet ebur; fusos cervix cui lactea crinis / accipit et molli subnectens circulus auro.
source.text_english: There among the ranks, behold, the Dardanian boy, Venus’ dearest charge, his noble face uncovered, shining like a gem that is set in yellow gold, either as an ornament for the neck or for the head; or like ivory gleaming when enclosed in boxwood or Orian terebinth, by artifice; his milk-white neck receives his flowing hair, and a circlet, fastening it beneath, with soft gold.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: illis Taenario pariter tremit ignea fuco purpura, quod gemina mater spectabile tela duxit opus; bis Taygeton silvasque comantes struxerat, Eurotan molli bis fuderat auro; quemque suus sonipes niveo de stamine portat et volat amborum patrius de pectore cycnus.
reuse.text_original: illis Taenario pariter tremit ignea fuco / purpura, quod gemina mater spectabile tela / duxit opus; bis Taygeton silvasque comantes / struxerat, Eurotan molli bis fuderat auro; / quemque suus sonipes niveo de stamine portat / et volat amborum patrius de pectore cycnus.
reuse.text_english: For them the fiery purple on Taenarian dye trembles likewise, because the mother drew together the splendid work with twin threads; twice had she woven Taygetus and its leafy forests, twice had she poured Eurotas with soft gold; and each horse carries its rider from snowy warp, and the native swan flies from the breast of both.
